description: Source code for managing an X11 window with custom compositing, including video frame rendering and manual window compositing for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment.

classes.name: SbWindowPrivate
classes.description: Class managing an X11 window with custom compositing, video frame rendering, and manual redirection for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment.

methods.name: HasNeededExtensionsForPunchedOutVideo
methods.description: Checks if the display supports necessary XRender and XComposite extensions for video punching.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the X11 window, setting up visual info, colormap, window properties, and creating necessary XRender pictures.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::~SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up X11 resources such as pixmaps, pictures, windows, and graphics contexts.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::BeginComposite
methods.description: Prepares the composition buffer, resizing if needed, and clears the composition pixmap.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::CompositeVideoFrame
methods.description: Uploads a video frame to an X11 pixmap, applies transformations, and composites it into the main composition.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::EndComposite
methods.description: Finalizes the compositing by blending the GL output and rendering the composed frame to the window.
